shared_elements: schematic engraved linear motifs on a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic engraved outline motifs, and each contains rounded eye- or disc-like shapes, but that is about as generic as rock-art correspondence gets. A shows a few very large curvilinear, mask- or body-like designs filling the whole boulder, whereas B is a crowded panel of small repeated crewed boats with tally-like strokes, quadrupeds in profile and stick human figures around a long ladder motif — an entirely different repertoire and density of scene.
